entries.note: The adapter's label for the order's createdAt. The portal shows "Your order is pending…" until a driver takes the order.
The adapter's label for the order's assignedAt. The portal shows "Your order is assigned to" and the driver's first name, which the adapter does not ask for.
A pick-up stop's completedAt. The portal shows "Your order has been picked up at" and the clock.
A drop-off stop's completedAt. The portal shows "Your order is delivered at" and the clock.
A drop-off stop completed with the reason ATTEMPTED. The portal's script shows "Delivery was attempted at" and the clock, and the status "Attempted".
A return stop's completedAt. The portal's script labels the stop "Return".
